sentences.en: Japan came under American pressure to open its financial market.
sentences.zh: 日本在美压力建立其金融市场。

sentences.en: He will never yield to the pressure of a politician.
sentences.zh: 他绝不会屈服于政治家的压力。

sentences.en: He has to have his blood pressure taken every day.

senses.zh: 压力，挤压；（气体或液体形成的）压力，压强；心理压力，紧张；催促，要求；气压
